41: // The linking data that has been collected on Docusaurus pages during SSG

44:   [pathname: string]: {links: string[]; anchors: string[]};

54: class BrokenLinksHelper {
55:   collectedLinks: CollectedLinksNormalized;
56:   validPathnames: Set<string>;
57:   remainingRoutes: RouteConfig[];
58: 
59:   constructor({
60:     collectedLinks,
61:     routes,
62:   }: {
63:     collectedLinks: CollectedLinksNormalized;
64:     routes: RouteConfig[];
65:   }) {
66:     this.collectedLinks = collectedLinks;
67:     this.validPathnames = new Set(collectedLinks.keys());

70:     // See https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus/issues/9754
71:     // Matching against the route array can be expensive
72:     // If the route is already in the valid pathnames,
73:     // we can avoid matching against it
74:     this.remainingRoutes = (function filterRoutes(
75:       validPathnames: Set<string>,
76:     ) {
77:       // Goal: unit tests should behave the same with this enabled or disabled
78:       const disableOptimization = false;
79:       if (disableOptimization) {

90:       validPathnameRoutes.forEach((validPathnameRoute) => {
91:         if (!validPathnameRoute.strict) {
92:           validPathnames.add(addTrailingSlash(validPathnameRoute.path));
93:           validPathnames.add(removeTrailingSlash(validPathnameRoute.path));
94:         }
95:       });
96:       return otherRoutes;
97:     })(this.validPathnames);
98:   }

106:       this.validPathnames.add(pathname);

139:       sourcePath === pathname ||
140:       sourcePath === decodeURI(pathname) ||
141:       addLeadingSlash(sourcePath) === normalizedPathname;

143:     // Link has no hash: it can't be a broken anchor link
144:     if (hash === undefined) {
145:       return false;
146:     }
147:     // Link has empty hash ("#", "/page#"...): we do not report it as broken
148:     // Empty hashes are used for various weird reasons, by us and other users...
149:     // See for example: https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus/pull/6003
150:     if (hash === '') {

152:     }

154:       collectedLinks.get(pathname) || collectedLinks.get(decodeURI(pathname));

157:     if (!targetPage) {

163:       validPathnames.has(lookupPath) ||
164:       validPathnames.has(pathname) ||
165:       validPathnames.has(decodeURI(pathname)) ||

235:   routes,

237:   collectedLinks: CollectedLinksNormalized;
238:   routes: RouteConfig[];
239: }): BrokenLinksMap {
240:   const filteredRoutes = filterIntermediateRoutes(routes);
241: 
242:   const helper = createBrokenLinksHelper({
243:     collectedLinks,
244:     routes: filteredRoutes,
245:   });

248:   collectedLinks.forEach((_unused, pagePath) => {
249:     try {
250:       result[pagePath] = getBrokenLinksForPage({
251:         pagePath,
252:         helper,
253:       });
254:     } catch (e) {
255:       throw new Error(`Unable to get broken links for page ${pagePath}.`, {
256:         cause: e,
257:       });
258:     }
259:   });
260:   return result;
261: }

263: function brokenLinkMessage(brokenLink: BrokenLink): string {
264:   const showResolvedLink = brokenLink.link !== brokenLink.resolvedLink;
265:   return `${brokenLink.link}${
266:     showResolvedLink ? ` (resolved as: ${brokenLink.resolvedLink})` : ''

271:   pagePath: string,
272:   brokenLinks: BrokenLink[],
273: ): string {
274:   const type = brokenLinks[0]?.anchor === true ? 'anchor' : 'link';
275: 
276:   const anchorMessage =
277:     brokenLinks.length > 0
278:       ? `- Broken ${type} on source page path = ${pagePath}:
279:    -> linking to ${brokenLinks
280:      .map(brokenLinkMessage)
281:      .join('\n   -> linking to ')}`
282:       : '';
283: 
284:   return `${anchorMessage}`;
285: }
286: 
287: function createBrokenAnchorsMessage(
288:   brokenAnchors: BrokenLinksMap,
289: ): string | undefined {
290:   if (Object.keys(brokenAnchors).length === 0) {
291:     return undefined;
292:   }
293: 
294:   return `Docusaurus found broken anchors!
295: 
296: Please check the pages of your site in the list below, and make sure you don't reference any anchor that does not exist.

298: 
299: Exhaustive list of all broken anchors found:
300: ${Object.entries(brokenAnchors)
301:   .map(([pagePath, brokenLinks]) =>
302:     createBrokenLinksMessage(pagePath, brokenLinks),
303:   )
304:   .join('\n')}
305: `;
306: }
307: 
308: function createBrokenPathsMessage(
309:   brokenPathsMap: BrokenLinksMap,
310: ): string | undefined {
311:   if (Object.keys(brokenPathsMap).length === 0) {
312:     return undefined;
313:   }
314: 
315:   /**
316:    * If there's a broken link appearing very often, it is probably a broken link
317:    * on the layout. Add an additional message in such case to help user figure
318:    * this out. See https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus/issues/3567#issuecomment-706973805
319:    */
320:   function getLayoutBrokenLinksHelpMessage() {
321:     const flatList = Object.entries(brokenPathsMap).flatMap(
322:       ([pagePage, brokenLinks]) =>
323:         brokenLinks.map((brokenLink) => ({pagePage, brokenLink})),
324:     );
325: 
326:     const countedBrokenLinks = _.countBy(
327:       flatList,
328:       (item) => item.brokenLink.link,
329:     );
330: 
331:     const FrequencyThreshold = 5; // Is this a good value?
332:     const frequentLinks = Object.entries(countedBrokenLinks)
333:       .filter(([, count]) => count >= FrequencyThreshold)
334:       .map(([link]) => link);
335: 
336:     if (frequentLinks.length === 0) {
337:       return '';
338:     }
339: 
340:     return logger.interpolate`

342: It looks like some of the broken links we found appear in many pages of your site.

344: We recommend that you check your theme configuration for such links (particularly, theme navbar and footer).

346:   }
347: 
348:   return `Docusaurus found broken links!

354: ${Object.entries(brokenPathsMap)
355:   .map(([pagePath, brokenPaths]) =>
356:     createBrokenLinksMessage(pagePath, brokenPaths),
357:   )
358:   .join('\n')}

362: function splitBrokenLinks(brokenLinks: BrokenLinksMap): {
363:   brokenPaths: BrokenLinksMap;
364:   brokenAnchors: BrokenLinksMap;
365: } {
366:   const brokenPaths: BrokenLinksMap = {};
367:   const brokenAnchors: BrokenLinksMap = {};
368: 
369:   Object.entries(brokenLinks).forEach(([pathname, pageBrokenLinks]) => {
370:     const [anchorBrokenLinks, pathBrokenLinks] = _.partition(
371:       pageBrokenLinks,
372:       (link) => link.anchor,
373:     );
374: 
375:     if (pathBrokenLinks.length > 0) {
376:       brokenPaths[pathname] = pathBrokenLinks;
377:     }
378:     if (anchorBrokenLinks.length > 0) {
379:       brokenAnchors[pathname] = anchorBrokenLinks;
380:     }
381:   });
382: 
383:   return {brokenPaths, brokenAnchors};
384: }
385: 
386: function reportBrokenLinks({
387:   brokenLinks,
388:   onBrokenLinks,
389:   onBrokenAnchors,
390: }: {
391:   brokenLinks: BrokenLinksMap;
392:   onBrokenLinks: ReportingSeverity;
393:   onBrokenAnchors: ReportingSeverity;
394: }) {
395:   // We need to split the broken links reporting in 2 for better granularity
396:   // This is because we need to report broken path/anchors independently
397:   // For v3.x retro-compatibility, we can't throw by default for broken anchors
398:   // TODO Docusaurus v4: make onBrokenAnchors throw by default?
399:   const {brokenPaths, brokenAnchors} = splitBrokenLinks(brokenLinks);

401:   const pathErrorMessage = createBrokenPathsMessage(brokenPaths);
402:   if (pathErrorMessage) {
403:     logger.report(onBrokenLinks)(pathErrorMessage);
404:   }

407:   if (anchorErrorMessage) {
408:     logger.report(onBrokenAnchors)(anchorErrorMessage);
409:   }
410: }

413: // JS users might call "collectLink(undefined)" for example
414: // TS users might call "collectAnchor('#hash')" with/without #
415: // We clean/normalize the collected data to avoid obscure errors being thrown
416: // We also use optimized data structures for a faster algorithm
417: function normalizeCollectedLinks(
418:   collectedLinks: CollectedLinks,
419: ): CollectedLinksNormalized {
420:   const result: CollectedLinksNormalized = new Map();
421:   Object.entries(collectedLinks).forEach(([pathname, pageCollectedData]) => {
422:     result.set(pathname, {
423:       links: new Set(pageCollectedData.links.filter(_.isString)),
424:       anchors: new Set(
425:         pageCollectedData.anchors
426:           .filter(_.isString)
427:           .map((anchor) => (anchor.startsWith('#') ? anchor.slice(1) : anchor)),
428:       ),
429:     });
430:   });
431:   return result;
432: }

435:   collectedLinks,
436:   onBrokenLinks,
437:   onBrokenAnchors,

443:   routes: RouteConfig[];
